horeca.hero.title: HoReCa Solutions
horeca.hero.subtitle: Frozen baking products tailored for hotels, restaurants, and cafés.
horeca.intro.title: Built for professional kitchens
horeca.intro.desc: Our HoReCa line is designed for high-volume service where consistency, speed, and quality matter every shift.
horeca.intro.p2: Keep puff pastry, filo, and fryer snacks on hand, then bake or fry only what the shift needs. Guests get a fresh result without a full pastry team on the line.
horeca.range.title: What kitchens order
horeca.range.subtitle: The same catalog bakeries use, packed for hotels, restaurants, and cafés.
horeca.range.puff.title: Puff pastries
horeca.range.puff.desc: Squares, twists, apple and cinnamon pockets, and cheese parcels. Bake them for breakfast buffets, pastry counters, and dessert plates.
horeca.range.dough.title: Pastry dough
horeca.range.dough.desc: Puff pastry sheets and filo for pies, banitsa, and savory bakes your kitchen finishes in-house.
horeca.range.fry.title: Fryer snacks
horeca.range.fry.desc: Breaded cheese, white cheese, and mozzarella sticks. Ready for the fryer when the bar or café gets busy.

horeca.steps.title: From freezer to the table
horeca.steps.subtitle: A short path that fits a busy service.
horeca.steps.store.title: Keep it frozen
horeca.steps.store.desc: Products stay in the freezer until the shift starts, so waste stays low and quality stays even.
horeca.steps.cook.title: Bake or fry to order
horeca.steps.cook.desc: Put only the portions you need in the oven or fryer. The rest stays frozen for the next cover.
horeca.steps.serve.title: Serve it warm
horeca.steps.serve.desc: Guests get a fresh bake or a crisp fry, plated the way your kitchen already works.

horeca.start.delivery.title: A delivery rhythm
horeca.start.delivery.desc: Cold-chain drops land on the days your freezer and service actually need them.
